name: El Niño / La Niña
summary: Strong El Niño: ONI +2.2, well above the +1.5 threshold
state: NOAA's Oceanic Niño Index for July–September was +2.16°C, well above the +1.5°C threshold for a strong event; the event reached 'super' status in September. Strong El Niños typically peak in northern winter. No new ONI value as of 2 Nov.
for_you: Expect disrupted weather worldwide: drought in Australia, southern Africa and Indonesia, and floods in parts of South America and East Africa.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — El Niño reaches super status

why: ENSO reshapes global weather for a year at a time — droughts, floods, hurricanes and crop yields.
drivers: Pacific trade winds and ocean heat content.
